scenarios.title: A failing gh rules read gives one bounded note without the token
scenarios.notes: Risk: gh stderr with a token reaches stdout. Try stderr with a token line plus HTTP 403, HTTP/2 404, and a token line with no status. Expect one note starting rules unknown on github:, the status code, no token text, every sample unchecked, ok true.

scenarios.title: A failing glab rules read gives one bounded note without the token
scenarios.notes: Risk: shim stderr and its secret reach the note and stdout. Try the glab stub failing with HTTP 401 and a token line, glab absent, and glab not signed in. Expect one note starting rules unknown on gitlab: and no secret in stdout or stderr.

scenarios.title: A gh failure with 10 MB of stderr finishes with a short note
scenarios.notes: Risk: the note or stdout grows with stderr. Put the secret in the first line, the last line and the middle of 10 MB. Expect a note under 200 characters, stdout under 20000 characters, ok true, and no secret anywhere. Also try a slow gh against FORGE_TIMEOUT. The 200 and 20000 numbers come from the slice plan.

scenarios.title: A missing tool or a timeout gives a one-line note of at most 200 characters
scenarios.notes: Risk: launch and timeout errors keep newlines, long text or paths. Try gh and glab absent from PATH, a timeout, and a launch error text of several lines and 5000 characters. Expect one line, at most 200 characters plus the prefix, a type-name fallback for empty text, and no home path in stdout.

scenarios.title: The failure text reads the exit status and the HTTP code only
scenarios.notes: Boundary: _forge_failure and _bounded through pycall.py. Try stderr that is empty, boom, HTTP 4031, HTTP 40, http 403 in lower case, two codes, a code inside a token, CRLF, NUL and unicode. Expect gh exited with status N, plus (HTTP ddd) only for one exact three-digit code. Never copy other stderr text. Never raise.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py preflight with gh and glab shims on PATH in a scratch repo
Fake glab that fails with chosen stderr and exit code
Call _forge_failure and _bounded with generated text through pycall.py
Measure note and stdout size and run time for 10 MB stderr

riskReason: One boundary, the forge CLI call in branches.py, with a secret-leak concern but no data loss and an easy fix.
notes: Tag order puts cli and security first. The medium cap keeps four profiles: cli, security, contract and limits. The spec states no number for limits; the 200 and 20000 limits come from plan.md.
